page.layout: One text column, printed page 451, with running text in Greek and Latin. Page number above the column. Signature "Ff 2" and catchword "cul-" below the last line.

main_text.p: Θήκλω, ἢ τῆς ὑδὲ ἀρεσκήνη ἀπ καλοῖς δικαίως, ὡς αἰάπηξις ἕζα τῆς ἁγίας, καὶ οἰκυμενικῆς ἐκ- τῆς Σωσόδε, οὐδὲν ἔπεσν ἔσιν, ἡ ἀποκήρυξις Βαρλαὰμ τε, καὶ Ἀκινδύνου. Ἰωὶ οἱ μεμφόμενοι δίκαιοι παῦτες τῆς καὶ ἐπιοσουῦ σωιεῖσιν τῇ τὰ Βαρλαὰμ, ἕ Ἀκινδύνου ἀπηπιεύμενοι. Ad hæc sancta Synodus, ad illam additionem, quam vos æquo animo ferre non posse affirmatis, dicit; immerito eam vocari additionem, tanquam quæ expositio est sanctæ & Oecumenicæ Sextæ Synodi, quæ nihil aliud est quam rerum Barlaami, & Acindyni abdicatio. Eam qui criminantur, manifesto deprehenduntur, etiam illis qui non ita cordati sunt, Barlaami, atque Acindyni res tutari. Horum itaque Schismaticorum decreto, additio, quæ expositio fit, non condemnatur. Nihil ergo concluditur, cum effertur, Græcos ad hæc usque tempora illas particulas in Symbolo non apposuisse, causam esse non consensum cum Latinis, sed reverentia maiorum suorum, & metus anathematismi Ephesini, licet præposteri. Nam si tanta esset reverentia, & metus anathematismi, non addidissent in suis, & postquam addidere, excusassent, additionem illam non esse novum, aut alienum dogma, sed expositionem dogmatis. quod posse absque læsione dogmatis fieri, Synodum Chalcedonensem Patres defendentes adversus eam cul-

page.notes: Greek line 1 to line 6 are only partly legible at this scan size: the words "Θήκλω", "ὑδὲ", "ἀρεσκήνη" and "δικαίως", the second line "αἰάπηξις ἕζα", and the names in the fourth to sixth Greek lines are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The text of the Latin part is clear. The Greek and Latin run together without a paragraph break; the Latin "adversus" is printed as "aduerfus" with long s, and "Nam si" as "Nam fi". The Greek is transcribed from the scan and not corrected.
